raw._auto_apps: AUTO launch list: App launch of anything else asks first. Use the Start Menu name or the exe name.
raw._auto_reports: Automatic reports to Studio (needs Sign in in the Gate window; owner only). send_automatically is the master switch. Each report is the filtered report (counts, zones, element names; never typed text or window titles) as a comment on the day's item GATE-yymmdd. Pictures (PNG/GIF, zipped folders up to attach_max_mb) go only to your encrypted Private tier, never to the shared record; the comment carries just their reference. never_block reports are text only. Limits: max per_hour an hour, a gap of min_gap_s between reports (never-zone blocks skip the gap), max per_day a day. Offline or signed out: queued in outbox\ and sent later. The Gate window's checkboxes override these.
raw._capture: Pictures stay on this PC (%USERPROFILE%\nodach-gate\shots and clips). screenshots: a cropped PNG of the target (element + margin) when it has no name or is custom-drawn/web content, before a confirm popup (shown in it), after an error or when the window looks unchanged, or when Claude calls capture_view. clips: the last clip_seconds of the window in front, kept in memory only at clip_fps, saved on an error, a glitch (the UI changed with no action while Claude was driving) or 'Keep last 10 s'. Never while a never-zone window is in front (a blank frame and the reason instead). The Gate window's toggles override screenshots/clips.
_changes: 1 (2026-11-20): first version, approved by Nowed (never-list and zones as built).

_changes.what: added never group 'secrets in files' after Gate read a recovery-codes file in Notepad

Nowed: never touch Desktop\Nodach\nodach_sec. Added nodach_sec and client_secret; element names or values naming a secret are now hidden in every window (Gate showed a file name inside nodach_sec in an Explorer window).

raw._comment: Nodach Gate trust zones. JSON has no comments, so every key starting with _ is a comment and is ignored. Edit your copy at %USERPROFILE%\nodach-gate\zones.json (Gate reloads it when it changes and keeps each version it has seen in zones-history\). Bump 'revision' and add a line to '_changes' when you edit, so the log shows which rules were in force. Words match whole words, case-insensitive. Process names match with or without .exe.
raw._confirm: CONFIRM: a small popup on your PC (Allow once / Allow for 10 min in this app / Block); after 60 s it counts as Block.
raw._confirm_apps: Apps where every click, key and typed text needs your OK (scrolling and reading stay automatic).
raw._gate_titles: Gate's own windows (the popup and the Gate window). Always never, so Claude can't press Allow on itself.
raw._never: NEVER: refused with a reason, no popup, no grant can open it. Checked against the window the action lands in (process name and title) and the target element's name. applies_to 'all' also hides reads (Snapshot/Screenshot are refused while it's in front, and its elements are cut out of any Snapshot); 'input' only stops clicks/keys/typing.
raw._shell_apps: Shells and system editors: launching them through App is never (it would be a way round the hidden PowerShell tool); input into one already open needs your OK.
